purpose: Prevent announcement dates, measurement periods, verification dates and region-specific prices from being collapsed into one asOf field.

run-rate.definition: Current-period revenue pace annualized; not audited revenue and not interchangeable with ARR.
run-rate.calculation: publisher/company disclosed annualized pace; retain the disclosed methodology when available
run-rate.accountingBasis: non-GAAP operating metric unless the source explicitly states otherwise

ARR.definition: Contracted or recurring subscription revenue annualized under the reporting company's definition.
ARR.calculation: store company definition, inclusions, exclusions and gross/net presentation

monthly-revenue.definition: Revenue recognized or reported for one calendar month.
monthly-revenue.calculation: do not annualize without a separate derived record

subscription-price.definition: Public list price for a named plan, region, billing period and tax treatment.
subscription-price.calculation: separate standard, introductory, promotional and partner-bundle prices

valuation.definition: Pre-money or post-money equity value at a named financing or market date.
valuation.calculation: store pre/post-money basis and round close/announcement separately

shipment-forecast.definition: Forecast shipment units or mix for a specified geography and period.
shipment-forecast.calculation: retain forecast vintage, scenario and YoY comparison base

engagement-hours.definition: A named population's aggregate time spent in a specified app category during a fixed period.
engagement-hours.calculation: retain geography, period, app taxonomy, device channel and data-provider methodology

consumer-app-spend.definition: Consumer spend observed or estimated through named app-store channels; not total company revenue or total addressable market.
consumer-app-spend.calculation: separate calendar revenue, run-rate, cumulative spend and forecast values

market-size-forecast.definition: Research-provider forecast whose included products, customers and revenue pools must be retained.
market-size-forecast.calculation: never reconcile broad companion/assistant markets with narrow mobile companion-app spend as if equivalent
